title: JSON schema for plex2pl config file.
description: configuration file to set required values for plex2pl

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON schema for type completion etc.

plexServerUrl.description: The URL of your plex server.

plexAuthToken.description: The token to authenticate with your plex server.

outDirectory.description: The output directory of the playlist files.

outputFormat.description: The playlist format to generate: 'jellyfin' creates editable playlists directly via the jellyfin API, 'jellyfin-xml' writes read-only native playlist.xml directories, 'm3u' writes .m3u files.

jellyfinServerUrl.description: The URL of your jellyfin server. Required for the 'jellyfin' output format.

jellyfinApiKey.description: A jellyfin API key (created in Dashboard > API Keys). Required for the 'jellyfin' output format.

jellyfinOwnerUserId.description: The jellyfin user ID set as the playlist owner. Required for the 'jellyfin' output format, optional for 'jellyfin-xml'.

verbose.description: If you want to show verbose output when running commands.
